worktree.setup: if command -v nucleus >/dev/null 2>&1; then nucleus worktree prepare; else echo "Nucleus unavailable; skipping worktree prepare"; fi && effigy setup && if command -v nucleus >/dev/null 2>&1; then nucleus worktree link; else echo "Nucleus unavailable; skipping worktree link"; fi
worktree.teardown: if command -v nucleus >/dev/null 2>&1; then nucleus worktree unlink; else echo "Nucleus unavailable; skipping worktree unlink"; fi

branchName.instructions: Use a short kebab-case name for the bounded change.

commitMessage.instructions: Use a short imperative subject; add scope when it helps review.

pullRequest.instructions: Lead with the outcome, link governing docs, and include validation evidence and unresolved items.
